question: With identical core sequences, seeds, model, no MSA/templates and recycles, is disabling the fast-kernels path alone sufficient to recover confident parent predictions?
purpose: Implementation-path diagnostic only; not a candidate-reward comparison or a source of affinity labels.
why_small_compute_may_be_worthwhile: A two-parent branch can separate one implementation factor without MSA service, new data selection, chemical modeling or six mutant re-runs. Historical fast-kernel success lowers prior suspicion; this is a cheap diagnostic, not a presumed fix.
authorization: This turn prepares only. A later explicit user instruction to start this prepared protocol authorizes its execution; no repeat confirmation required within these bounds.
input_chemistry: Unchanged Q92843 1-164 + standard Bim_A2eT 23mer; core proxy, Q133 and all omitted chemistry retained.

baseline.reuse: Compare with existing same-seed parent outputs; do not rerun baseline or rescore it.

msa_policy.rationale: No local Bcl-w homolog MSA database or target-specific A3M was found. A remote MSA service has not been called; this draft avoids third-party service use.
msa_policy.deviation: The earlier application draft proposed a shared receptor MSA. This local single-sequence mode is an explicit pre-score method change and must remain attached to any result.

budget.budget_meaning: Process wall-time cap, not integrated GPU utilization.

preflight_before_future_start: Re-read applicable AGENTS and latest user steering; confirm original integrity and input/config SHA256.
Check executable, installed batch source SHA256 a65a1fb4301ae82de8b307a8d698f327a79b8fa66c8f053f4ddeff52c87020c4 and model weights against original hashes; no version switch.
Record CUDA/JAX/runtime versions and GPU free memory; GPU total about 8GB is not a reservation; do not kill unrelated jobs.
Confirm output root absent; if occupied prepare and record unique new root before any prediction.
Use a budget watchdog for process wall/disk caps; stop on OOM, NaN, error or changed inputs; retain all failures, do not change seed/model/recycles to rescue.
Retain baseline effective MSA1/1 and all derived config fields; report differences derived from the kernel option rather than concealing them.

quality_gate_unchanged.interface_pae_definition: Maximum PAE over all directed receptor-to-peptide and peptide-to-receptor residue pairs; pass only if <=10 A.
quality_gate_unchanged.peptide_plddt_definition: Mean C-alpha pLDDT over all peptide-chain residues; pass only if >=70.
quality_gate_unchanged.iptm_definition: AFM summary ipTM; pass only if >=0.70.
quality_gate_unchanged.clash_definition: Minimum heavy-atom interchain distance must be >=1.5 A; otherwise fail the structural gate.

other_required_gates: Exact A164/B23 sequences and contiguous numbering
At least one unique heavy-atom-defined residue contact <=6 A
After identical restrained Amber relaxation, minimum interchain heavy-atom distance >=1.5 A

additional_diagnostic_gate.note: Added engineering readiness check; never retroactively changes original pilot pass count.

frozen_branch_decision.2_of_2_all_gates_pass: Evidence that the changed implementation path is sufficient for this parent under these seeds; consider a separately prepared continuation, with mutant scoring still unauthorized.
frozen_branch_decision.1_of_2_all_gates_pass: Seed-sensitive/partial result; HOLD. No reroll or claim of a rescued reproducible system.
frozen_branch_decision.0_of_2_all_gates_pass: Disabling fast kernels alone does not recover the parent. HOLD this branch; does not prove all runtime factors innocent or MSA/chemistry causal.
frozen_branch_decision.confidence_improves_without_gate_pass: Report only descriptive change, classify as gate failure; no new success threshold.
frozen_branch_decision.any_execution_failure: Count failed job and stop; preserve logs; no automatic fallback or new parameters.

source_and_direction_boundaries.full_benchmark: HOLD; insufficient source labels/backgrounds and exact assay input
source_and_direction_boundaries.given_pose_scoring: HOLD; any future template/experimental-pose branch changes the scientific question and requires separate pose/mapping freeze.
source_and_direction_boundaries.future_ties_and_denominators: Do not change v2 0.05 GraphPep/FoldX tie bands; all formally eligible labels retain failures/ties in denominator; not calculated here.
